resolution.note: Obsolete after the no-gates loop: krn deliver/ship/review-gate ceremony is retired (PRs #258/#259), merges go through GitHub auto-merge.

title: Stop archiving worktree state in krn ship cleanup
body:
GLOBAL `krn ship` cleanup still writes `.krn/archive/worktree-runs` tarballs. Operator 2026-10-27: no archives by default; keep review records only and delete the rest.
Acceptance: ship cleanup keeps review records and deletes other worktree state; tests cover both.
